method: Learn antisymmetric molecular property differences using cross-scaffold fitting pairs, reconstruct query values from fitting-only assay anchors, similarity-weighted median and mean; compare a matched direct GPU regressor
screen: All nine continuous tasks undergo CV without an official-valid veto. Validation gains are recorded, never used to shorten training.
selection: 0.45 valid +0.55 CV mean -0.06 SD normally; 0.15 valid +0.85 ring-adjusted CV -0.06 SD when valid/test cyclic fractions differ by >0.5. Eligible objective>0.001, CV mean>0.0005, at least two adjusted folds improve, valid gain>-0.02. Local declines allowed.
fresh_repartition: After freezing the selection, refit selected source on a new 20% scaffold holdout from train+valid, compare pair variant to direct control. Diagnostic only; historically reused labels, not new external data.
limitations: Official formula and per-task scores unknown. Historical validation and CV proxy reused; paired rows are correlated. Ring adaptation uses test chemistry only, not target labels. New repartition is a diagnostic on previously used data, not an independent score estimate. No guaranteed platform gain.
